stitle: Terms of use for the AlphaPM online platform.

content: § 1. General provisions
1. These Terms and Conditions set out the rules for using the AlphaPM online platform.
2. AlphaPM is owned and operated by [name of entity / full name of the business owner], hereinafter referred to as the “Operator”.
3. AlphaPM is an online platform designed to support work organization, project management and collaboration between users.
4. The Platform is intended in particular for entrepreneurs, businesses, teams and individuals organizing their own work.
5. Use of AlphaPM may be free of charge or subject to a fee, depending on the selected Plan.
6. These Terms and Conditions set out the rights and obligations of the Operator and Users, as well as the conditions for using the Platform.
7. By starting to use AlphaPM, the User accepts these Terms and Conditions.
§ 2. Definitions
For the purposes of these Terms and Conditions, the following definitions apply:
1. AlphaPM / Platform – the online service that enables work organization and project management.
2. Operator – the entity responsible for operating and maintaining AlphaPM.
3. User – a natural person using the Platform.
4. Account – an individual User profile that enables the use of AlphaPM.
5. Organization – a company, business or team using AlphaPM.
6. Organization Administrator – a User authorized to manage an Organization.
7. Project – a separate workspace for organizing and storing information related to a particular undertaking.
8. Plan – a version of AlphaPM that defines the available features and limits.
9. User Data – information relating to the User, their Account and their activity on the Platform.
10. User Content – information, materials and other content posted by the User on the Platform.
§ 3. Registration and Account
1. Creating an Account is required to use AlphaPM features that require authentication.
2. Registration and login may be provided through external authentication service providers, in particular Google.

3. When Google login is used, the Operator may obtain from that provider information necessary to create and operate the Account, including in particular the email address, User identifier and other information made available under the permissions granted.

4. By using an external authentication mechanism, the User acknowledges that information made available by its provider may be used by the Operator to create and operate the Account, in accordance with applicable laws and the Privacy Policy.
5. The User must use the Account in accordance with the law and these Terms and Conditions.
6. The User is responsible for properly securing access to the Account, in particular for protecting authentication credentials and external accounts used to log in.
7. The User should promptly notify the Operator of any suspected unauthorized access to the Account.
8. The Operator may apply Account verification procedures to the extent justified by the security of the Platform or applicable laws.
§ 4. Organizations and collaboration
1. Users may create Organizations and join Organizations created by other Users.
2. The Organization Administrator is the User who has been granted the relevant permissions.
3. The Organization Administrator is responsible for properly managing members’ access to Organization resources within the features available on the Platform.
4. Users must comply with the confidentiality and information security rules applicable to information they have accessed.
5. The Organization Administrator should inform its members about the rules for using the Platform and the internal rules applicable within the Organization.
§ 5. Rules for using the Platform
1. The User agrees to use AlphaPM lawfully, in accordance with good practice and these Terms and Conditions.
2. The Platform must not be used for unlawful activities, activities that infringe third-party rights or activities that compromise the security of other Users.
3. The User is responsible for User Content posted on the Platform and for holding the rights and authorizations required to make it available.
4. The User must not take actions that could disrupt the proper functioning of AlphaPM, compromise its security or result in unauthorized access to data.
5. The Operator does not acquire ownership rights to User Content solely because it has been posted on the Platform.
§ 6. User content and comments
1. The User is responsible for ensuring that the content they post complies with applicable law.

2. It is prohibited to publish unlawful content, in particular content that infringes copyright, personal rights or the rights of others, or violates laws concerning the prevention of discrimination and incitement to hatred.
3. The Operator may take action regarding content that violates these Terms and Conditions or the law, in particular after receiving an appropriate report.
4. The Operator reserves the right to restrict access to or remove content where there is a legitimate legal or contractual basis for doing so.
5. Any action taken regarding content will comply with applicable law.
§ 7. Free and paid Plans
1. The Operator may offer different Plans for using AlphaPM, with varying features and limits.
2. The detailed features, limits and prices of individual Plans are presented before an agreement is concluded or a purchase is made.
3. A User on a paid Plan receives access to the features and limits provided for that Plan.
4. If a subscription ends, is not renewed or is changed to a Plan with lower limits, the User may lose access to some features or exceed the limits applicable to the new Plan.

5. If, following a Plan change, the number of Projects assigned to the User or Organization exceeds the limit for the current Plan, excess Projects may be subject to functional restrictions, hereinafter referred to as “Project suspension”.
6. The User may select which Projects are to be suspended so that the remaining Projects fall within the limit of the current Plan.
7. If the User does not select Projects for suspension within the period specified by the Operator, the Operator may automatically suspend the Projects that have been inactive for the longest period.

8. A suspended Project remains available in read-only mode. The User may view the information and existing content in it, but may not add new tasks, comments, files or other content, or modify existing data.
9. Suspending a Project does not mean that it is deleted or that the data stored in it is lost.
10. Full functionality of a Project may be restored by switching to a Plan that provides a sufficient limit or by freeing up capacity under the current Plan.
11. Detailed rules for billing, subscription renewals, cancellations and any refunds are set out in the purchase terms presented to the User before an agreement is concluded.
12. The Operator will inform Users of material changes to Plans, prices and the scope of services in accordance with applicable law.
§ 8. Rights and obligations of the Operator
1. The Operator agrees to provide services to the extent resulting from the selected Plan and the agreement concluded.
2. The Operator takes appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the proper functioning and security of AlphaPM.
3. The Operator reserves the right to carry out technical, maintenance and update work.
4. The Operator may develop, change or modify the Platform’s features, subject to existing agreements and applicable law.
5. The Operator exercises due care to protect data stored on the Platform but does not guarantee that all security incident risks can be eliminated.
6. The Operator uses external infrastructure and technology service providers whose operations may affect the functioning and security of AlphaPM.

7. The Operator makes efforts to keep AlphaPM available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (24/7). However, the Operator does not guarantee uninterrupted availability of the Platform, in particular in the event of technical failures, maintenance, updates, issues with external providers’ infrastructure or other events beyond the Operator’s control.
8. The Operator is not liable for consequences resulting from the User’s culpable or irresponsible conduct, in particular:
• sharing login credentials with unauthorized persons
• using the same passwords across multiple services where this results in unauthorized access
• entering login credentials on fraudulent websites, including phishing websites
• using unsecured devices or networks in a way that compromises Account security
9. The provisions limiting the Operator’s liability do not exclude or limit liability to the extent that such exclusion or limitation is impermissible under applicable law.
§ 9. Data security and confidentiality
1. The Operator applies appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect information and data stored on AlphaPM.
2. To provide its services, the Operator may use infrastructure and services supplied by external providers, including in particular:
• Supabase
• Oracle
• GitHub
• other providers necessary for the proper functioning of the Platform
3. The use of external providers means that some processes related to the functioning of the Platform may remain outside the Operator’s direct control.
4. The Operator does not guarantee complete data security against all possible threats, in particular those resulting from failures, vulnerabilities or incidents on the part of external providers.
5. The Operator takes steps to reduce the risk of such events and responds to identified incidents in accordance with applicable law.
6. The User must properly secure their Account and use the Platform in a way that does not expose data to unauthorized access.
7. The User must not access Accounts, Projects or information for which they do not have the appropriate authorization.
8. Detailed rules for the processing and protection of personal data are set out in the Privacy Policy and, where required, in separate data processing agreements.
§ 10. Copyright and source code
1. AlphaPM, including its source code, structure, graphic design, name, logo and other elements comprising the Platform, is owned by the Operator or by entities holding the relevant rights.
2. All elements of AlphaPM are protected under applicable intellectual property laws, in particular copyright law.
3. Public access to AlphaPM source code, in particular through platforms such as GitHub, is for informational purposes only and allows users to review its contents.
4. Public availability of the source code does not transfer copyright, waive those rights or grant Users a license to use the code beyond the rights arising under mandatory provisions of law.
5. Without the Operator’s prior express consent, the following are prohibited in particular:
• copying and distributing the source code
• using the source code in other projects
• making and distributing modifications to the code
• providing the code to third parties for further use
• using AlphaPM elements in a way that infringes the Operator’s copyright

6. The above rules may not apply to individual components, packages, extensions or other elements for which the Operator expressly grants a separate license defining the permitted scope of use, modification or distribution.
7. The User retains copyright in User Content posted on the Platform.
8. The User grants the Operator a non-exclusive authorization to use User Content to the extent necessary to provide the services, maintain the Platform and deliver AlphaPM features.
9. This section does not limit rights arising under mandatory provisions of law.
§ 11. Account deletion and data retention
1. The User may request Account deletion in accordance with the procedure available on the Platform or by contacting the Operator.
2. Upon receiving a request to delete an Account, the Operator will take steps to delete the User’s data associated with that Account.

3. The Operator may retain data associated with the Account for up to 2 months from the date of its deletion, to the extent necessary to complete the deletion process, handle billing and security matters, and address potential claims.
4. After the period specified in section 3, the Operator deletes or anonymizes the data, except where further retention of certain information is required or permitted by applicable law.
5. The Operator may retain selected information for longer than 2 months if necessary, in particular:
• to comply with legal obligations
• to establish, pursue or defend against claims
• in connection with court, administrative or other proceedings conducted by authorized authorities
• to document violations of these Terms and Conditions or the law, including unlawful content posted by Users
6. Data retention under section 5 is limited to what is necessary for the relevant purpose and to the period required by applicable law or the Operator’s legitimate needs.

7. Deleting a User’s Account does not necessarily mean that data belonging to an Organization will also be deleted, where continued retention is justified by the Organization’s rights, existing agreements or applicable law.
8. Detailed information about data deletion and retention periods is available in the Privacy Policy.
§ 12. Complaints
1. The User may submit complaints regarding the functioning of AlphaPM to the following email address: [email].
2. A complaint should include a description of the issue and information that will enable it to be identified and reviewed.
3. The Operator will review complaints within the time limits and in accordance with the rules set out in applicable law and the relevant service terms.
4. The Operator may ask the User to provide additional information necessary to review the complaint.
§ 13. Amendments to the Terms and Conditions
1. The Operator reserves the right to amend these Terms and Conditions for legitimate reasons, in particular in the event of:
• changes in the law
• development or changes to AlphaPM features
• changes in the way services are provided
• technical or organizational changes related to the operation of the Platform
2. Users will be notified of material changes to the Terms and Conditions in an appropriate manner.
3. Changes to the Terms and Conditions relating to ongoing agreements and subscriptions will be made in accordance with applicable law and the terms of those agreements.
4. If an amendment requires the User’s renewed acceptance, the Operator will enable the User to provide it before continuing to use the services, to the extent required by law.
§ 14. Final provisions
1. These Terms and Conditions take effect on [date].
2. Matters not covered by these Terms and Conditions are governed by the applicable laws of Poland and the European Union.
3. The Operator may be contacted at the following email address: [email].
4. If any provision of these Terms and Conditions is found to be invalid or ineffective, this will not affect the validity of the remaining provisions.
5. Any limitations of the Operator’s liability set out in these Terms and Conditions apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law.
